id64.description: ID64 of the body, a 64 bit unsigned integer.

body_id.description: ID of the body in the system, an 8 bit unsigned integer.

updated_at.description: The timestamp that the body was last updated, in UTC.

system_controlling_power.description: Name of the controlling power of the system.

system_power_state.description: State of the controlling power for this system.

system_id64.description: ID64 of the system, a 64 bit unsigned integer.

is_main_star.description: Stars only.  Whether this is the main star of the system or not.

distance_to_arrival.description: Distance to the system arrival point of the body, measured in Kilometres.

surface_temperature.description: Surface temperature of the body, measured in Kelvin.

age.description: Stars only.  The age of the star, measured in solar years.

solar_masses.description: Stars only. Mass of the star, as a ratio of the mass of Sol.

solar_radius.description: Stars only. Radius of the star, as a ratio of the radius of Sol.

earth_masses.description: Planets only.  Mass of the planet, as a ratio of the mass of Earth.

radius.description: Planets only.  Radius of the planet, measured in Kilometres.

gravity.description: Planets only.  Gravity of the planet, as a ratio of the gravity of Earth.

surface_pressure.description: Planets only.  Surface pressure of the planet, measured in atmospheres.

orbital_period.description: The orbital period of the body, measured in days.

semi_major_axis.description: The semi major axis of the body, measured in Kilometers.

orbital_eccentricity.description: The orbital eccentricity of the body.

orbital_inclination.description: The orbital inclinction of the body, measured in degrees.

arg_of_periapsis.description: The argument of periapsis the body, measured in degrees.

mean_anomaly.description: The mean of anomaly the body, measured in degrees.

ascending_node.description: The ascending node of the body, measured in degrees.

rotational_period.description: Rotational period of the body, measured in Days.

is_rotational_period_tidally_locked.description: Whether the rotational period of the body is locked to the tides.

axis_tilt.description: Axial tilt of the body, measured in radians.

is_landable.description: Planets only.  Whether the planet is landable or not.

orbital_synchronicity.description: The absolute difference between the orbital period and the rotational period.

estimated_scan_value.description: Estimated reward from scanning the body.

estimated_mapping_value.description: Estimated reward from mapping the body.

signal_count.description: Count of the number of signals on the body.

signals_updated_at.description: The timestamp that the signals were last updated, in UTC.

value.description: Estimated reward from scanning the landmark.

landmark_value.description: Total value of all the landmarks on the body.

parents.description: Parents of the body, mapping each parent body type to it's ID within the system.

id64.description: ID64 of the parent body, a 64 bit unsigned integer.

stations.description: All stations which are known on the body.
